description: Shows the sandbox agent's spending limits, what has been spent in each window and what is left. Use it before a paid call when the remaining budget matters, or after a refusal to see which limit was hit. Returns the agent name and mode, the per-request limit, the approval threshold, what happens when a budget is exceeded, the allowed hosts and one line per window (hourly, daily: spent, limit, remaining). Read-only; changes nothing.

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox_id returned by sandbox_create (32 hex characters)
